task.description:
Implement the UAT Tenant URL feature per the design at src/design/uat-tenant-url.md. NOTE: This is primarily a FRONTEND-DEV task but is assigned to BACKEND-DEV because the changes are in web/tests/e2e/pipeline.ts (TypeScript test helpers) and docs/ (documentation). No Zig code or SQL migrations are needed.

Changes to make:

1. web/tests/e2e/pipeline.ts:
   a. UAT-TM-01: Add optional realm parameter (default bpm-default) to getKeycloakToken() and refreshTokenIfNeeded(). Remove hardcoded KEYCLOAK_TOKEN_URL, build dynamically.
   b. UAT-TM-02: Add new resolveTenantContext(request, companySlug, adminToken) function that calls GET /api/v1/tenants/{slug} and returns { tenantId, realm, slug, tokenUrl }. Add caching per slug.

2. docs/agents/UAT_RUNNER.md:
   c. UAT-TM-03: Add Step 2.5 (Resolve tenant context) between Step 2 and Step 3. Update pre-flight check to verify /api/v1/tenants/{slug} endpoint.

3. docs/agents/uat-scenario-schema.md:
   d. UAT-TM-04: Add a note that company_id is the sole tenant identifier and UAT Runner resolves it automatically.

4. Commit implementation to feature branch feature/WF02-uat-tenant-url-20260607.

IMPORTANT: This task involves TypeScript and documentation, NOT Zig. You can read and edit these files but you do NOT need to run zig build or zig build test. After implementation, verify with:
  - cd web && npm run type-check (must exit 0)
  - cd web && npm run lint (must exit 0)
acceptance_criteria: getKeycloakToken() accepts optional realm parameter with default bpm-default
refreshTokenIfNeeded() passes realm through to getKeycloakToken()
resolveTenantContext(request, companySlug, adminToken) function exists and returns TenantContext
UAT_RUNNER.md has Step 2.5 for tenant context resolution
uat-scenario-schema.md has note about company_id automatic resolution
All existing pipeline tests still work (backward compatible)
